lines.1: 「Fish is the main event tonight. Now devour it like a starving lion cub.」
lines.3: I tore into it like a wild animal.
lines.4: 「Hey, that's taking it too far. That bonito was expensive.」
lines.6: 「Tch, what am I gonna do with a growing boy like you? Make sure you eat the asparagus kinpira too.」
lines.7: 「Oh, right. I ran into Yoppi at the produce shop.」
lines.9: 「She looked right at home doing the shopping. Like some young bride a lecherous rice merchant would have his eye on.」
lines.10: 「That's only because you look completely wrong walking around with green onions sticking out of a shopping bag.」
lines.11: 「Anyone would look picturesque next to you.」
lines.12: 「...So, what do you think of girls like Yoshimi?」
lines.13: 「Well, she seems like she'd know how to make her man look good, but don't you think something might be missing?」
lines.14: 「Just because you're handsome doesn't mean you can be that picky.」
lines.16: 「What about you, kid? If you want to go for her, I'll root for you with all my heart. Yoppi, the Princess, Director Tachibana--whoever.」
lines.18: 「Come on. I gave you a setup, so give me the comeback.」
lines.19: After Subaru went home, I lay in bed and started to doze off.
